subject: tsDyn: back on CRAN, with version 0.9-33

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: tsDyn: back on CRAN, with version 0.9-33
parts:
Hi

tsDyn is finally back on CRAN, with a new version 0.9-33, which is
mainly a maintenance version, correcting the minor issues that led it to
be temporarily out of CRAN. In addition to this, it corrects a bug in
VARrep() found by Paul Schreck (thanks!), as well as a bug in resvar().
See the Changelog for more details.

Best

Matthieu
